claims.answer: The product owns a scriptable reevesagents CLI and terminal UI, with JSON output and MCP over the same runs. reevesagents web serves a work interface on 127.0.0.1 with live agent terminals; the README documents SSH forwarding from another machine. The CLI/TUI host runs on macOS, Linux, WSL and native Windows 10 1809+. This does not establish a packaged graphical desktop client. The UI/CLI can spawn, follow, prompt, interrupt and stop agents; run history persists.

claims.answer: With Agent Control attached, the host CLI is recorded as a run head and spawned agents as workers. The host receives spawn, read, send_text, send_key, interrupt, list and stop tools. Text submission is a separate Enter operation. ReevesAgents supplies the MCP control tools and run-head/worker relationship while the native host CLI reasons about delegation. Agent Control is off by default. Use attach for the chosen supported host CLI, then restart that CLI; worker tools require separate explicit attachment.
